senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to be still,] to watch, guard, wait; to observe; to keep.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 63b:2-5">Snh. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>לא … שְׁמוֹר לי וכ׳</he> one should not say to his neighbor, wait for me at such and such an idolatrous statue (or temple).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 58a:8">B. Mets. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>השוכר … לִשְׁמוֹר את וכ׳</he> if one hires a workingman to guard a cow, a child &c.

<cite ref="Shabbat 118b:4">Sabb. 118ᵇ</cite> <he>אלמלי שָׁמְרוּ ישראל וכ׳</he> if Israel had observed the first Sabbath &c.; a v. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="U01443"><he>שָׁמוּר</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="U01441"><he>שְׁמוּרָה</he></cite> &c. Ib. XXII, 4 <he>נותנין … בשביל שיהא ש׳</he> you may put a dish into the well that it be kept (cool); a. e.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="U01524">same</cite>. Ib. 118ᵇ <he>אילמלי מְשַׁמְּרִין ישראל וכ׳</he> if Israel would observe two Sabbaths as they ought do, they would at once be redeemed.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 62b:10">Keth. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>ענייה זו לשוא שִׁימְּרָה</he> the poor woman has in vain waited (for her husband).

<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 4:11">Ab. Zar. IV, 11</cite> <he>אין … יושב ומְשַׁמֵּר וכ׳</he> the watchman (guarding wine against idolatrous defilement) need not sit and watch &c. Y. Kidd. I, 58ᵈ top <he>המקום משמר וכ׳</he> God has watched, and such a case has never occurred. Y. M. Kat. III, 82ᶜ <he>שי׳ הקב״ה … שבעה</he> the Lord observed the seven days of mourning for his world (before the flood, ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 7:10">Gen. VII, 10</cite>); a. fr.

senses.gloss: (denom. of שְׁמָרִים) to clear wine from lees, filter, strain (v. מְשַׁמֶּרֶת).
units: Sabb. 138ᵃ שי׳ חייב וכ׳ if one filtered wine (on the Sabbath), he is bound to bring a sin-offering; Y. ib. XX, 17ᶜ; VII, 10ᵇ, a. e. המשמר חייב שום בורר he who filters is guilty &c., v. בָּרַר. Ib. המשמר יין למטן וכ׳ when one filters, the wine goes down, and the lees remain above (in the filter); a. fr.—Bab. ib. 146ᵇ מקום העשוי לְשַׁמֵּר a place in the keg where a hole has been made for the purpose of letting the wine off, clear of lees (and has been closed again; Ar. s. v. חזק; Rashi: where the hole has been closed in order to preserve the flavor).—Part. pass. מְשׁוּמָּר

<cite ref="Pesachim 109b:5">Pes. 109ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="U01527"><he>שמרים</he></cite>, <cite ref="Exodus 12:42">Ex. XII, 42</cite>) <he>ליל המש׳ ובא מן המזיקין</he> a night which is for all time guarded against dangers (v. <cite ref="M00757"><he>מַזִּיק</he></cite>); <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 11b">R. Hash. 11ᵇ</cite>.—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 11b">Ib.</cite> <he>ליל המש׳ ובא מששת וכ׳</he> a night which has been designated for redemption since the six days of creation.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 99a">Snh. 99ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 34b:24">Ber. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>יין המש׳ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P00942"><he>עֵנָב</he></cite>; a. e.
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: to be on one’s guard, be observant. Mekh. Bo, s. 14 (ref. to שמרים, v. supra) מגיד … צריכין להִשְׁתַּמֵּר בו this intimates that all Israelites must be careful in it (to observe its ceremonies); Yalk. Ex. 210; Tanḥ. Bo 9.

units: <cite ref="Eruvin 54b:8">Erub. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>אם ראשון … מִשְׁתַּמֵּר וכ׳</he> if the fowler breaks the wings of each bird as he catches it, it is kept (from flying off) &c.
<cite ref="Menachot 99b:6">Men. 99ᵇ</cite> <he>כל המשמר … נשמתוֹ משתמרת</he> who guards the Law (takes care not to forget it), his soul is guarded; a. e.

senses.gloss: same, to be on one’s guard. Ib. כל מקום שנאמר הִשָּׁמֶר פן ואל וכ׳ wherever the Scripture has the words, ‘be on thy guard, lest’, or ‘be on thy guard that not’, it is a prohibitive law; ib. השמר ופן וכ׳ ‘be on thy guard’ and ‘lest’ make two prohibitions. Ib. 36ᵇ השמר דלאו לאו hishshamer followed by a negative is a prohibitory law; השמר דעשה עשה hishshamer connected with a positive order, is a positive command (v. עָשָׂה).—[Tanḥ. Vayḥi 13 ומשמירין, v. שָׁפַר.]
